card.name: Linking words in nursing-mother and geriatric statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "is", "and", "to" and commas in label sentences. Most often the "is" in "It is not known whether this drug is excreted" under Nursing Mothers, and the "and" or comma in geriatric/renal dosing sentences.

modes.label: Nursing mothers opening
modes.description: The word "is" or "whether" in the standard "It is not known whether this drug is excreted in human milk" sentence.

modes.label: Linking word in elderly or renal sentences
modes.description: An "and" or comma joining clauses about kidney excretion or dose selection in older patients.
